---
title: "Scatter by location"
description: "Colour responses by location to compare soundscapes."
date: 2026-01-02
categories: [scatter, grouping]
---

```{python}
#| label: fig-scatter-by-location
#| fig-alt: "Scatter plot grouped by location"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
import soundscapy as sspy

data = pd.read_csv("../../assets/DemoData.csv")

sspy.scatter(
    data,
    title="Scatter plot grouped by location",
    hue="LocationID",
    diagonal_lines=True,
    alpha=0.7,
    s=30,
)
plt.show()
```
